brook.ability: Mending tide · heal up to 20 health
brook.bonus: +4 maximum health, rising to +6. Every fifth damaging weapon hit heals 1 (+2 at bond III).
brook.hint: Choose at Keeper Sera’s shrine, or discover through Fishing. After your first bond: 1 in 12 per successful action, guaranteed on a successful action at level 10 or above.
brook.name: Brook

cairn.bonus: +4 armour, rising to +6. Hits of 4 or more deal 1 less damage (3 or more at bond III).
cairn.hint: Choose at Keeper Sera’s shrine, or discover through Mining. After your first bond: 1 in 12 per successful action, guaranteed on a successful action at level 10 or above.
cairn.name: Cairn

cinder.bonus: Every fourth damaging weapon hit on the same foe deals +1 damage (+2 at bond III).
cinder.hint: Choose at Keeper Sera’s shrine, or discover through Firemaking. After your first bond: 1 in 12 per successful action, guaranteed on a successful action at level 10 or above.
cinder.name: Cinder

flint.ability: Faultline · earth strike and 6 seconds of slow
flint.bonus: +2 armour. Every fifth damaging weapon hit adds +2 damage (+3 at bond III) and slows its target for 1 second.
flint.hint: Rare twin of Cairn. After finding Cairn, each successful Mining action from level 11 has a 1 in 2,000 chance. No guaranteed drop.
flint.name: Flint

gale.bonus: 20% less run energy used; +2 accuracy from 3 tiles. Every fourth damaging weapon hit restores 4–6 run energy.
gale.hint: Rare twin of Zephyr. After finding Zephyr, each successful Woodcutting action from level 11 has a 1 in 2,000 chance. No guaranteed drop.
gale.name: Gale

pyre.ability: Emberburst · fire damage in a small area
pyre.bonus: Switching between melee, ranged and magic damaging hits adds +1 damage (+2 at bond III), at most once per 6 seconds.
pyre.hint: Rare twin of Cinder. After finding Cinder, each successful Firemaking action from level 11 has a 1 in 2,000 chance. No guaranteed drop.
pyre.name: Pyre

rill.ability: Renewal · restore up to 24 health over 12 seconds
rill.bonus: +1 armour (+2 at bond II). Every fourth damaging weapon hit on the same foe restores 1 health (+2 at bond III).
rill.hint: Rare twin of Brook. After finding Brook, each successful Fishing action from level 11 has a 1 in 2,000 chance. No guaranteed drop.
rill.name: Rill

zephyr.ability: Gust · wind strike and 3 seconds of slow
zephyr.bonus: 15% less run energy used. At least 3 tiles away, ranged and magic gain +4 accuracy, rising to +6.
zephyr.hint: Choose at Keeper Sera’s shrine, or discover through Woodcutting. After your first bond: 1 in 12 per successful action, guaranteed on a successful action at level 10 or above.
zephyr.name: Zephyr
